lines.zh: 我用五只眼睛看路，慢慢游。
lines.en: I swim slowly, watching the way with five eyes.
My long snout probes ahead.

lines.zh: 暖海的浅底上，我贴着泥走。
lines.en: On the warm sea floor I keep close to the silt.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地摆着身子。
lines.en: My body flexes in segments.
I pass between the sea grasses.

lines.zh: 冷海的水很清，我看得远。
lines.en: The cold sea is clear; I can see far.
My lobes fan the water one by one.

lines.zh: 我在底下留下细细的痕。
lines.en: I leave a thin trail on the bottom.
When I settle, the sand lifts.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚礁的缝里挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap in the reef.
I swim toward the brighter water.
I make one slow turn.
My snout tip stirs up a little mud.
I sniff the seabed the whole way.
The current carries me a stretch.
I hover above the seabed, still.

lines.zh: 我的五只眼睛各看一边。
lines.en: My five eyes each look a different way.
My long snout hangs down.
My lobes fan slowly.
The cold of the seabed slows me.

lines.zh: 我在看一条小鱼绕石头。
lines.en: I'm watching a small fish circle a stone.
My body glows faintly.
I settle onto the mud to rest.
I tuck myself into the sea grass.
My shadow falls to the seabed.
I turn to a new angle, slowly.

lines.zh: 你有两只眼睛，我有五只。
lines.en: You have two eyes. I have five.
What brings you down here?
My snout is longer than your arm.

lines.zh: 我在浑水里也看得见你。
lines.en: I can see you in murky water too.
Don't tread on the silt.
I don't know a shape like yours.
Your colors are too bright.
I'm slowly turning toward you.
The water tastes entirely of you.
My eyes can't judge distance well.
I curl up and my lobes fold.
One of my lobes has stopped moving.
I burrow a little into the mud.
On a soft body, wounds like this run deep.
I drift, unable to hold a heading.
Everything wobbles in my eyes.
I ease back behind the reef.

lines.zh: 我头上这五只眼，都花了。
lines.en: All five eyes on my head blur.
Something's sinking down below.

lines.zh: 我只滤水里的碎屑，你的不算。
lines.en: I filter scraps from the water, not from your hand.
It's sunk into the mud.
I sift the drifting scraps slowly.
I might eat what you drop.
These crumbs aren't enough.
I can't tell what that is.
I only eat what settles.
Don't wave your hand in the water.
You kicked up a cloud of silt.
The surge pushed me aside.
My snout touched your leg.
I'm soft as a ribbon.
All five of my eyes look at you.
I swerve around your feet.
Two things squeezed in one narrow gap.
Silt got in my eyes.
Neither of us liked that.
There's another of me on the sea floor.
It swims slower than I do.
We swam side by side a while.

lines.zh: 我们分食了水底的东西。
lines.en: We shared what lay on the bottom.

lines.zh: 它的五只眼睛都朝着我。
lines.en: All five of its eyes were on me.
We circle the same reef stone.
The water clouded and we parted.
It sank, and I followed.
We never met again.
I pin it under my snout tip.
This one sinks fast.
I curl a lobe around it.
It's turned up out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我用五只眼盯它，想了想。
lines.en: Five eyes fix on it while I think it over.
I push it into a rock crevice.
I can drag this much.
What sinks is mine.
I swallow it slowly.
Something's moving down here.
I turn all five eyes toward it.
The taste of the water changed.
I rise a little for a better view.
That thing is too big.

lines.zh: 五只眼分开转动，各看一处。
lines.en: My five eyes turn apart, each watching a different way.
I see the edge of a shell.
It's stirring mud; I wait.
I don't like that direction.
I press against a stone.
I get ready to swim back.
I watch it and slowly retreat.
The current hides my shape.
When it moves, the mud rises.

lines.zh: 我五只眼睛一起看着你。
lines.en: All five of my eyes are on you.
I hover outside its line of sight.
I rise a little, slowly.
I hear it moving.
There's a crevice near here.
I drift toward deeper water.
I can wait longer.
I pull my snout back a little.
I jab with my snout tip.
That had almost no force.
I curl around it and let go.
I'm pushed into a spin.
I only meant to push it away.
I hit its hard shell.

lines.zh: 长长的吻撞偏了，戳进泥里。
lines.en: My long snout misses and stabs into the mud.
I swim back to the crevice.
My lobes have curled up.
At least that distracted it.
I withdraw slowly into deeper water.
I rise out of the silt.
The sea floor is quiet enough.
Seawater flows through my gills.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次看清这片底。
lines.en: This is the first clear look at this bottom.
I come out from behind a reef stone.
The water is cold. I like it.
A few beats of my lobes and I'm steady.
My five eyes each look somewhere.

lines.zh: 这里的泥很软，我的吻部探进去了。
lines.en: The mud is soft; my proboscis sinks in.
I settle down to the sea floor.

lines.zh: 我顺着冷水慢慢移上来。
lines.en: I drift up with the cold water.
Nothing down here has moved.
I poke my long snout from a rock crevice.
I want to scout this whole bottom first.

lines.zh: 水都被烧热了，我往下沉。
lines.en: The water itself burns hot; I sink away.
I'm thrown from the water onto the shore.

lines.zh: 在水里竟然也会喘不上气。
lines.en: Somehow I can't breathe, even in water.

lines.zh: 水底炸开，我被推得翻滚。
lines.en: The bottom bursts and I tumble.
An arrow sinks into my soft body.
Light spreads underwater and I stiffen.
There's little left to eat down here.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我撑不住身体。
lines.en: No water here; my body won't hold up.
